# Dermio

> Dermio turns a daily selfie into a clear skin score — and shows you, week after week, whether your routine is actually working.

Dermio: AI Skin Scan & Score — Acne Tracker & Glow Journal. iPhone app, available on the App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6794270397?pt=128839649&ct=ai_web

## Guides

- [How to Build a Daily Skincare Routine on iPhone](https://jjjulietttee-jpg.github.io/lumi-app/how-to-build-a-skincare-routine-on-iphone): Get a morning and evening skincare routine matched to your skin type and goal on iPhone, with reminders and streaks.
- [How to Check Your Skin Glow Score on iPhone](https://jjjulietttee-jpg.github.io/lumi-app/how-to-check-your-skin-glow-on-iphone): Get a 0 to 100 skin glow score from a selfie on iPhone and learn how to read it over time.
- [How to Track Acne and Skin Progress on iPhone](https://jjjulietttee-jpg.github.io/lumi-app/how-to-track-acne-progress-on-iphone): Track breakouts and other skin metrics with a daily selfie on iPhone, and see whether your routine is working over weeks.
